blocks.text: You’re drifting through the streets of España. Headphones in and the world muted; your mind is elsewhere. Then you look up. “ARE YOU LOST IN THE CITY TOO? – L.L.” For a while, that question lived on the wall of the infamous Manila waiting shed until it was recently painted over, erasing the rest of the graffiti. But the blank wall didn’t stay blank for long. Days later, a new message appeared: “LOVE IS ALL WE HAVE.” The same shed that had once carried L.L.’s now-famous question had found another voice.
